description: This file implements a Zephyr-based input device driver for LVGL touch input via keyboard scan, including callback registration, input reading, coordinate transformation, and initialization.

methods.name: lvgl_pointer_kscan_callback
methods.description: Callback function invoked on keyboard scan input, enqueues input data into message queue.

methods.name: lvgl_pointer_kscan_read
methods.description: Reads input data from message queue, applies coordinate transformations based on display orientation and configuration, and outputs the processed input data.

methods.name: lvgl_kscan_pointer_init
methods.description: Initializes the keyboard scan device, registers callback, and sets up the input driver.
